## getKeyPolicy() function

Read the governance policy attached to an API key.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare function getKeyPolicy(keyId: string): GovernancePolicy | undefined
```

**Returns:**

[GovernancePolicy](./core.governancepolicy.md) \| undefined

The stored policy, or `undefined` when the key has none (the common case — a per-key policy is opt-in, and its absence means the host policy alone governs).

## Exceptions

[KeyPolicyError](./runtime.keypolicyerror.md) when a policy is stored but cannot be decrypted, parsed, or validated.
